question: Who among the following succeeded the throne of the Mughal Dynasty in India after Akbar?
solution:
The correct answer is __Jahangir.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Jahangir (1605–1627)

 
• Akbar was succeeded by Salim, who ascended the throne in October 1605 under the name of Jahangir.
 
• Jahangir is remembered for the chain of justice
 
• Jahangir hanged Arjundev, the 5th Guru of the Sikhs for helping his rebellious son Khusaro.
